# Clipboard+ Desktop

> Clipboard+ Desktop is a free clipboard manager for macOS, Windows and Linux. It keeps a searchable history of everything you copy (text, links and images) on your computer, works fully offline with no account, and can optionally sync across all your computers and the Clipboard+ browser extension when you sign in or use an API key. Voice dictation in any app, with private on-device Whisper transcription, is built in. (Also known as Whisper Dictation & Clipboard+.)

- Website: https://tommyqhoang.github.io/whisper-dictation/
- Clipboard+ (account, website and browser extension): https://clipboardplus.apercallc.com
- Contact: https://apercallc.com/contact

## Two ways to use it

- Local (default): free, no account, no sign-up. The history is saved only on this computer and works offline. Nothing is sent anywhere.
- Synced (optional): connect a Clipboard+ account in Settings with email and password, or with an API key (for accounts created with Google: in the Clipboard+ account open Developer API and create a key with clipboard read and write access). Text and links then appear on every macOS, Windows and Linux computer signed in to the same account, in the Clipboard+ browser extension, and on the website. Images stay on the device they came from. Clearing history can clear everywhere at once. Disconnect any time.

## Key facts

- Price: free. On-device transcription has no cost; an external transcription API (OpenAI, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint) is optional and may charge.
- Platforms: macOS, 64-bit Windows, and Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE; GNOME on Wayland supported). Linux is the most tested; macOS and Windows support is newer.
- Clipboard history shortcut: Super+Shift+F (Linux), Win+Shift+F (Windows), Control+Option+Shift+F (macOS). Type to search, Enter copies the top result. Changeable or can be turned off in Settings.
- Dictation shortcut: Super+Shift+D (Linux), Win+Shift+D (Windows), Control+Option+Shift+D (macOS). Press, speak, press again, paste.
- Default speech model: a verified 148 MB Whisper model downloaded once; audio never leaves the computer. English, or multilingual with automatic detection.
- Privacy: the microphone turns on only when the shortcut is pressed. Clipboard history is opt-in, skips items password managers mark as secret, and can be paused for an hour or until resumed.

## Install

- macOS or Linux, in Terminal: bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tommyqhoang/whisper-dictation/main/bootstrap.sh)"
- Windows (x64), in PowerShell: & ([scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tommyqhoang/whisper-dictation/main/bootstrap.ps1).Content))
- The installer adds only missing dependencies, downloads the app, and opens it. First-run setup asks whether to use Clipboard history, Dictation, or both.
